ways.label: Mangakara Nature Walk loop from the end of Grey Road

start.name: End of Grey Road
start.quote: turn left turn into Grey Road and follow this to the end

via.name: Mangakara Stream
via.quote: takes you to the beautiful Mangakara Stream before looping back

via.name: Bridge
via.quote: Please note the track sign across the bridge and veer right to stay on the Nature Walk

evidence: The walk meanders through an ancient forest, with large rimu, kahikatea, tawa, pukatea and kohekohe and takes you to the beautiful Mangakara Stream before looping back.
The track starts 11 km north of Pirongia.
Take the first left turn into Hodgson Road, then turn left turn into Grey Road and follow this to the end.

not_on_route.name: Pirongia
not_on_route.quote: The track starts 11 km north of Pirongia

doubts: The order of the Mangakara Stream and the bridge on the loop is not certain; the numbered posts (bridge at post 5, stream at post 10) are not tied to named places. Direction is not stated.
